products.product_name: Women's Powder Lite™ II Mid Jacket
products.search_term: Columbia Women's Powder Lite™ II Mid Jacket

reviews.body: I live this cost! It is light weight, yet duper warm! I ended up with an XL and am glad because it gives me room for extra layers- I would say sizing is right on point. I love the hood as it stays in place yet isn’t too bulky. All in all a great coat and excellent price!

Took a trip to NYC recently. I wanted a longer coat but wanted something light weight due to traveling. I ordered this coat but sized up from 2x, to 3x just incase it ran small. I would say it is at least true to size if not a little large. I would have exchanged for the 2x or maybe even xl after trying on. I have large biceps and often coats are tight for me there. I was able to wear several layers and felt comfortable with sweater and sweatshirt. The coat kept me very warm and even felt comfortable with just wearing a long sleeve shirt. I am 5’5 and typically wear 2x shirt and 18-20 bottoms. I didn’t test it out much but it seems to withstand water as well. The sleeves were just slightly too long for me but have small elastic band at end so that helped. Loved the navy color and matches well with accessories. Packs up easy and I could fit the whole coat in a backpack style purse if needed.

I honestly really liked this coat it was just too big for me. The color is beautiful and Columbia is a name I trust as my winter jacket is from them and have had it for years. Keeps me toasty. This had the same mining. I will probably reorder in a smaller size.

products.product_name: Women's Columbia Lodge™ Sherpa Full Zip Fleece Jacket
products.search_term: Columbia Women's Columbia Lodge™ Sherpa Full Zip Fleece Jacket

reviews.body: Love, love this fleece. The fleece is so warm and soft and I constantly reach for it during winter. It is well designed with a function zipper and zipper pockets. It layers nicely and I have washed it several times and the softness and cozy material are all intact. I purchased this on sale - would buy again. I purchased one size up for a more baggy cozy feel but could have gone with my regular size without issue.

The color is exactly as pictured. Fits perfectly. I typically wear a medium sized shirt so I ordered the large in this so I could wear it over bulky clothes. It fits perfectly. Extremely soft and cozy. Seems well made. Columbia has nice quality merchandise. I ordered this to replace a Columbia jacket that I have had for about 8 years. The zipper finally broke on my old one. Columbia's prices tend to be a bit higher than some but their products last a good long while.

It’s not the most thick per se but it’s really warm. I love these jackets a lot. The pattern is super cute and they stay really nice and soft even after washing. I tend to size up for a larger fit but these truly are true to size. I got this on sale so the price was awesome. It’s not super fluffy where it looks tacky either.

products.product_name: Women's Mountain Croo™ III Mid Down Jacket
products.search_term: Columbia Women's Mountain Croo™ III Mid Down Jacket

reviews.body:
I spent years looking for a waterproof insulated winter jacket that’s also light and allows good freedom of motion for PNW. This is the one, the search is finally over!!
I first tried an older beautiful red color version on at REI 3 years ago, but they didn’t have my size. So last year I got a dark green from Columbia store directly, a bit bummed about the red color being unavailable anymore. My mom tried my jacket on and instantly wanted one too, so we got an agreement that she can keep my green one if I can find a color I like better. This year I found it in pink here, and I love it!!! Now both me and my mom are cozy and dry this winter.
Highly recommend, it’s comfortable, warm, waterproof, great hood and pockets, and it looks great too!
Not warm enough for me so returning it.
Fit was perfect and my friend absolutely loves it

products.product_name: Women's Powder Lite™ II Hooded Jacket
products.search_term: Columbia Women's Powder Lite™ II Hooded Jacket

reviews.body: This is the perfect mid weight jacket for where I reside in the Midwest. It’s good for temperatures 30+ and above.

Columbia jackets are always top quality, and I had to replace a jacket because I lost weight. Was hesitant about the blue/green color, I receive compliments every time I wear it. Not a bulky jacket and yet it still keeps me warm without overheating. I ordered size Small (5' 6" and 115#).
Perfect jacket. Super lightweight and versatile and extremely warm!

products.product_name: Women's Joy Peak™ II Mid Hooded Jacket
products.search_term: Columbia Women's Joy Peak™ II Mid Hooded Jacket

reviews.body: Both my daughter and two granddaughters love this coat. The extra length provides protection and warmth to their knees in really cold weather. It is light weight, but provides great warmth. This coat runs true to size. It was a good buy for all three.

This jacket has become my new preferred choice. I appreciate the fit and the weight, as it provides warmth and sufficient length. The thumb hole feature effectively keeps the sleeves in place. It appears to be constructed from high-quality materials. I would certainly consider purchasing this jacket in a different color.

I am 5'7", 126 lbs., 36B and a normal size 4 (sometimes 2 with vanity sizing). I ordered this in Small in the collegiate navy based on reviews that it ran a little small. In brands like Eddie Bauer and Land's End I wear XS for reference. The fit DOES run a little small but it fit perfectly with one polar fleece underneath. If you are larger than a 36B, you should size up as the chest DOES seem to run small. I have a Columbia heavenly long jacket in small and it does run larger than this. This one is roomier through the hips though with plenty of room for movement. I really like the length but see how it could be unflattering for shorter people as it is pear shaped. The thumbholes and fleece around the hood are a nice feature. It will be several months before I see how warm it is but look forward to wearing it. The hood is not removable but that wasn't a dealbreaker for me.

products.product_name: Women's Suttle Mountain™ Long Insulated Jacket
products.search_term: Columbia Women's Suttle Mountain™ Long Insulated Jacket

reviews.body:
Absolutely love this jacket. It’s warm without feeling bulky, super comfortable, and perfect for everyday wear in cooler weather. The fit is flattering and true to size, and the quality is exactly what you’d expect from Columbia. I really appreciate how lightweight it feels while still keeping me cozy. It looks great dressed up or casual, and I’ve gotten so much use out of it already. Zipper quality is awesome YKK… IYKYK!!! Definitely recommend if you want something stylish, practical, and well-made. It has 2 decent size pockets and one breast pocket, could have done better with the amount of pockets and depth, but functional overall.
For reference I am 5’5” 160 lbs and I ordered a size large and I had plenty of extra room to layer underneath if needed.
This coat was really warm! Purchased for 15° weather. It kept me dry and warm and wasn’t overly bulky. It fit over my many layers as well. I like that it was long and able to cover my thighs.

This coat is beautiful. It is heavier than I usually wear and is water resistant. The hood is huge and I have a head that is on the higher end of average (over 22 inches). The color is very vibrant and it both zips and buttons with huge pockets in the front and a zipper pocket on the breast which is plenty big enough for a phone. No pockets on the inside, which I wish it had since I will be traveling in the winter in Europe and that would keep my passport and money safer. This coat is not for temperatures above freezing in my opinion (but I live in a northern state and am used to the cold). It is also longer than the usual winter jacket, which is great. I may update after spending some time in very cold weather.

reviews.body: I really like this jacket! I've worn it in 10 degree weather here in Michigan and it keeps me warm. It's not bulky and puffy like all these puffer coats. It's very easy to put on, warm, has a nice hood, and inside pocket and zipper pockets, also with the loops in the sleeves for your hands to go through! Well worth the price! Fast shipping, too! I purchased the black, size 2X. The quality is the best, and sizing is perfect. Keeps me very warm. I'm 5'5", 190 lbs., and 46 bust, and about 48 hips. I like some room in my clothing. The only thing I wish this jacket had was an alternative of snapping also with the zipper. Other than that....it's the perfect Winter in Michigan jacket!! Perfect length, too!
Fits perfect and love the color! Great light weight coat but also keeps you warm!

I needed a warm and water resistant coat for a winter trip to NYC. I had my eye on this coat for a while, but originally ordered a less expensive, different brand of coat from a competitor store. They sent me the wrong coat, so I came back to this one. I have a thin Columbia windbreaker that I love, so was hoping this would be THE COAT.

Y'all. It's *almost* perfect. It's not bulky at all, but it is incredibly - surprisingly - warm. I loved the longer length and the sleeves with the thumbholes. I'm around 5'6", size 10 women's and ordered a large. I was easily able to layer a baselayer t-shirt and a medium weight sweater underneath and i didn't feel like the poor kid all bundled up in "A Christmas Story." The inside zipper pocket was *chef's kiss* for stashing my tiny zip wallet and OMNY card as we went about our day. It is sleek and not like an enormous puffer coat , so if I did take it off indoors to carry it was lightweight and wasn't like lugging around a king size down comforter.

The only, and I mean only, negative was that putting the hood on and zipping all the way up was a bit uncomfortable. I opted for a hat so that didn't pose an issue. It honestly was not enough of an issue for me to dock a star - it's that great of a coat!

Hoping it lasts through several winters and more travels!

products.product_name: Women's Heavenly™ Jacket
products.search_term: Columbia Women's Heavenly™ Jacket

reviews.body:
I had a Columbia winter coat but it was time for a new one. I spent some time looking around and found 2 that I liked. This was one of them. I ended up getting both. This as a lightweight winter coat for those not quite so cold days. The other is for those days when it's freezing outside.

Since I've had Columbia coats before, I knew that my frame (5'2", 110lbs, bra size of 34 A) would fit best in an XS, so that's what I ordered. It arrived quickly, packaged well and fit exactly as it should. I love that it isn't bulky and is a bit more form fitting, but I can still wear a sweater underneath without feeling constricted. The zippers glide easily and it has pockets that are deep enough to hold my phone.

It's comfortable and flattering but also great at blocking the wind and dealing with colder temps. There is no hood on this, so if it's raining out, you'll need a different coat or a hat if you don't want your hair to get wet.

As I stated above, this is a lightweight jacket that is great for temperatures around 40 degrees and above. Once it dips below that around here, I grab my other Columbia coat that is better suited for below freezing weather.
Light weight puffer, super cute can be a dressed up or more casual. Even with it being a not so puffy puffer the heat holding liner keeps you warm in the cold.
Very nice coat. Has warmth,style and not bulky. Looks great with jeans or dress clothes

reviews.body: Very nice and warm winter coat. The length is nice and is definitely designed to be used for snow activities with pockets, thumb holes on hand part of inner sleeve and interior closure to block out snow for falls. Should come in very handy on the slopes!
Excellent in all ways. I am 5'7", 180 lbs and a large fits perfectly. Can layer a sweatshirt underneath comfortably.
It's the perfect fit, great color, provides needed warmth in the winter!!! Great timing on the shipping as well!

products.search_term: Columbia 1 / 4 Women's PFG Open Water™ Poncho

reviews.body:
I love it. It's light weight so I can wear it most of the year. I live in the southern region of the USA so the summer temperatures can be brutal. The coat is well made, stylish, and great price. It has 2 outside pockets and 2 inside that are roomy. I can fit my wallet, car keys, etc. , with room to spare. The last thing I want to do when a deluge of rain hits is carry a purse and I don't have to with the generous pocket space. I also don't need and umbrella as the hood on this coat thoroughly covers my head and keeps me dry.
I'm very happy with my purchase and look forward to wearing it for many years.

I had a black one of these that I’ve used for 5 years or more and it is still going strong. I use it so much all year long I decided I wanted another in a fall color. Got one on a pumpkin orange color. Fits perfectly exactly as the black. Very good nearly all year long. Keeps on warmth when zippered up to the chin. Adjustable wrists and nice foldable hoodie. Rainproof. Easy to wash. Love.
Light weight and waterproof ! Its neat that the hoodie can took in and out. Also protected very well against high winds.

products.search_term: Columbia New Colors Women's Benton Springs™ Full Zip Fleece Hoodie - $49.00

reviews.body: Fits true to size, form fitting shape, longer torso length for warmth, with hood for extra protection. Great layering item during frigid temps to wear under my winter parka which is also from Columbia. Versatile spring and fall coat too.

Bought as a gift for my mother. Very soft and nice quality that you expect in a Columbia fleece. This is longer than the standard fleece and it has a hood! My mom loves the hood and said she has been asked twice in public where she got a Columbia fleece with a hood! Washed well and keeps her warm. I am watching out to get one for myself!

Love the coat. This coat is true to size.
I am 5'4" around 200 lbs. I bought a 2X. The coat is cozy and love that it zips up. I think I could possibly have gotten a XL but thinking that I may wear a sweatshirt or sweater underneath it gives me the extra room. It fits well and does not make me look too boxy like some coats. I feel it is made to be loose and comfortable but also to show our curves and waistline. The only con is that the sleeves are too long for me. This is always an issue for me so I always just roll up the sleeves because I am just 5'4" and kind of chunky so my arms are shorter. I think somebody with longer arms that are probably 5'6" or taller the arms would work great. So give it try.

products.product_name: Women's Eastmoreland™ Lined Long Jacket
products.search_term: Columbia Women's Eastmoreland™ Lined Long Jacket

reviews.body:
I've ordered this specific Columbia jacket style in size XXL twice but in different colors. This review is going to be for the Razzle coat. It does run larger than the Black color, although they are the same size.

This jacket does have a lot of positives to it, namely, that it covers my bottom and it's a great price for a longer, lightweight rain jacket. The inner lining has a cottonish/rayonish/ kind of velvety feeling fabric so it seems breathable and provides a little bit of warmth, but it's not as easy as sliding on as say a mesh lining or plastic lining would be. The zipper slides up and down easily. The hood covers my head and hair, but I wish the adjusters were different...they are kind of flat and you have to pinch to adjust. It's an attractive shape on my figure for a raincoat, and it has a slight flare at the bottom. I didn't notice much noise from the outer material.

The cons for me are the sleeves are very long, almost covering my fingertips. They are also quite large, almost frumpy looking. I'm 5'8, around a size US 14/16 with wide hips and carry weight in my lower belly. I'm not busty. This color comfortably fit around my stomach/hip area and accommodated that area nicely when sitting down and I didn't fear the zipper would split. I tried this on with a light/medium density sweater.

I wasn't able to test the efficacy as I returned it. I may try another color and see if it fits comfortably around the stomach area while not looking frumpy elsewhere. I'm also attaching photos of a few other Columbia styles I've tried on. Hope this helps someone trying to find an attractive, yet affordable raincoat.

I bought this jacket so I can walk in our Seattle rain. It’s lined but not a heavy jacket. It keeps we warm and dry but I don’t overheat in it on my walks. Style and quality is spot on. Normally it drizzles a lot where I live. This jacket fits me perfectly. The hat keeps the rain out of my face. I got it on sale for $29. Great value for the money. Definitely recommend it. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I am a true to size XL/14 to 16 depending on the brand and I ordered a 2X and it fit PERFECTLY. I’m so glad I read the review to size up because it does run small. That being said, it’s perfect for cold California weather. Very lightweight, lining is soft and comfortable and great for drizzle weather. Folds up nicely, not bulky at all and covers my bum and hips but still looks flattering. I probably can’t wear a bulky sweater under this, but it’s great for T-shirts underneath or a thin, long sleeve. Definitely keeping and recommending this. Worth the money!

products.search_term: Columbia Women's Castle Dale™ Full Zip Fleece Jacket

reviews.body: My mom has one in pink, and it looked nice, so I bought one. This jacket looks exactly as shown. It's thick, fuzzy, and really warm, not a light spring jacket. The cut is flattering (curvy but not tight in the waist). The quality is great (what you'd expect from Columbia) and is easy to wash (although I hang-dry mine because it's black and I hang dry all my black clothes in case they fade). Love the zip-up side pockets —deep enough for your whole hands. A pocket on the arm for a card or money is nice too.

When I came across this Columbia jacket in the shade of my favorite color I was all over it!! How can something so lightweight be so warm? When I put it on I am immediately went to underneath my AC vent where on a normal day I cannot stay for even two seconds because the air is that cold. With the jacket on I was super toasty and honestly shocked how warm it truly was. I really really like the back being a tad longer because my back bends forward leaving the lower part of my waist always exposed, but not with this; there was zero air getting through. The fit was fabulous. I am 5‘11“ And weigh about 150, I chose the extra extra large because I do not like short sleeves and wanted to make sure the sleeves went past my wrist which it does. It is very comfortable and could see it being worn a long time without it feeling bulky or trapped, unable to move freely. The quality of Columbia is outstanding as always. Do not let the price scare you away. It is absolutely worth it. 100%.
